publication_policy: Portable historical evidence only, not an executable packet or admission/qualification permit. Local paths, chat UUIDs and XML hostnames are removed; original raw-file hashes are retained separately from hashes of these exports. No banks, predictions, weights, checkpoints, environments or raw process inventories are exported. Originals remain unchanged outside Git.
